title: Verdict panel member verdict v0.1
description: What one member of a verdict panel ends its output with. The runner (server/utils/workflowRunner.ts, the panel step) parses the last JSON object carrying a `verdict` key out of the member's output, validates it against this file, and stores it under the run's artifacts as panel/<agentSlug>.json. A member whose output holds no object that passes this schema counts as a fail: a reviewer the runner could not read is a reviewer whose objections are unknown. Kept deliberately small - the subset of JSON Schema that shared/utils/verdictPanel.ts validates without a dependency.

verdict.description: The member's one answer. `fail` needs at least one criterion marked fail, or a risk, or it is sent back for the evidence.

ticket.description: The ticket this verdict is about, as the member was told it. A verdict naming another ticket is refused.

criteria.description: One entry per acceptance criterion the member judged. A member asked to judge one criterion lists that one.

risks.description: What the member could not rule out, in one line each. An empty array is an honest answer; a missing key is not.

evidence.description: The command and its output, or file:line, that the result rests on. A pass with none is read as unproven by the aggregator's reviewers.
